title: console: the 环境 list still reads meta/view twice per open (objectui#13044 residual): a settled view list needs refresh and every in-SPA view write (incl. PackagesPage publishDrafts) to drop it
body:
Filed by `domain:ui` seat 2 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectui#9771, session `session_01XVp19E1MYUTFM3dnkwz8gB`) as the residual of objectui#13044 (PR #13053, seat ruling `6268839381` (d)). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is left

The objectui#13044 card's acceptance asks that one full open of cloud's 环境 list reads `GET /api/v1/meta/view` once (objectstack-ai/cloud#2914 Target 1). PR #13053 shares that read in flight only, so the measured console order costs **2**, down from 3:
1. the provider's eager view read lands first;
2. `listViews` and `listViewOverrides` then share a second request.

Getting to 1 needs a settled `list:view` entry in the adapter's `MetadataCache`. The seat ruled that a settled entry may ship only when every path that should see fresh views drops it. Two of those paths were outside objectui#13044's surface:

- **User refresh:** `refreshData` in `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx` re-reads the view list through `listViews`. A settled list would serve it stale for the cache TTL (5 min).
- **In-SPA view writes that bypass the adapter:** the `MetadataClient` publish and save paths in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/**` and `views/studio-design/**`. One of them, `PackagesPage` `publishDrafts`, emits no metadata-refresh pulse at all, so even the provider's caches are not dropped after it. That reading is static inference from grep in the dev report `6269447021` on objectui#13044 and is not reproduced.

## Target

- One `meta/view` per open, through a settled `list:view` that a user refresh and every in-SPA view write drop. The writers are enumerated and pinned.
- Every publish path emits the metadata-refresh pulse the others emit.

## Acceptance

- The 环境 list open reads `meta/view` once (pin in `MetadataProvider.oneMetadataRead-13044.test.tsx`, today 2).
- `refreshData` re-asks.
- Each enumerated writer drops the entry, with an ablation per writer class.
